event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Hot CPI, oil bid, rotation out of small caps.
Nov CPI printed 0.4% m/m vs 0.3% fc (core 0.3% vs 0.2%), and CME FedWatch now prices a 100% December hike. That kept mega-cap tech only mildly lower while small caps and rate-sensitives bled, and the bid went to energy on a +465.7 crude build headline. Positioning is defensive into tomorrow's PPI (6.6% y/y fc).

INDICES — VIX 18.7, below its 19.4 20-day MA but VIX futures +3.43%.
QQQ -0.32%, SPY -0.35%, DIA -0.38%, IWM -1.64%. Large > small by 0.86pp. Most notable cross-asset move: TLT -1.48%, with gold -2.82% and silver -3.28% — a real-yield repricing, not a risk-off haven bid. SPY and QQQ sit above their 200-day MAs; no CTA sell trigger.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SOXX 2.4x and GLD 1.5x are the attention names; QQQ 0.7x, IJR 0.6x and DIA 0.4x are being ignored.
SPY vol_ratio 0.9x on a down day = orderly, not distribution. QQQ 0.7x on -0.32% = low-conviction drift, no accumulation signal. Breadth diverges hard: only 25% of S&P 500 names advanced, up/down volume 0.28, and just 70%/61% above the 50/200-DMA with 18 new highs vs 7 lows — a narrow mega-cap tape, not a broad one.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLE Energy +1.51%, XLU Utilities -0.02%, XLK Technology -0.34%, XLP Staples -0.43%, XLY Discretionary -0.44%, XLRE Real Estate -0.52%, XLV Healthcare -0.59%, XLF Financials -0.72%, XLI Industrials -0.89%, XLC Comms -0.96%, XLB Materials -1.28%.
Top industries USO +3.25% and UNG +2.35%; bottom WGMI -4.92% and MSOS -5.39%. Flows confirm the leadership: XLK +$1,260mm (100th pctile) and XLV +$109mm, against XLC -$1,065mm (2nd pctile) and XLF -$802mm (15th). Money-in is energy and AI hardware; money-out is comms and financials. Rotation state: AI hardware leading.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.25 and QQQ PCR 1.46 show real protection demand, reinforced by QQQ skew +13.1%.
QQQ spot is near its 700 gamma flip with max pain 685 — dealer hedging amplifies moves from here. VIXEQ 43.4 vs VIX 18.7 is a wide gap: high single-stock dispersion, a rotation tape. MOVE is blank; no bond-vol read.

CROSS-ASSET — Crude +3.25% (USO) into the 465.7 build is the odd one — supply data bearish, price bullish, so the move is positioning, not barrels.
Gold -2.82% with the dollar +0.24% and TLT -1.48% is a coherent hike repricing. Next FOMC Dec 9: CME FedWatch 100% hike; Polymarket 88% for +25bp (5d +11pp), 10% for +50bp.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 65.9, Greed.
AMD +5.86% and AVGO +5.54% led on the chip rebound; IVE -0.43% on 10.1x volume (style rotation, not news). NVDA -4.34% on 4.5x volume is distribution and the tape's real tell. Watch: NVDA (4.5x vol into gamma), SOXX (+2.4x vol, -0.26% today but +17.51% 5d — squeeze risk both ways), GLD (-2.82%, 1.5x vol, PCR 0.48 = no fear yet).
